item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"DIW reported that the Federal Constitutional Court declared the transfer of unused COVID emergency funds into the Climate and Transformation Fund unconstitutional, creating substantial uncertainty for the federal budget and planned investment.","notes":["The excerpt supports the ruling and its implications but does not state the €60 billion amount."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"After the ruling, the federal government declared an emergency for the 2023 budget so the debt brake could be suspended; the cited assumptions and coalition agreement involved €17 billion in core-budget cuts and €12.7 billion in cuts to Climate and Transformation Fund spending, while retaining EEG compensation.","notes":["The excerpt does not mention efficient-building-renovation programs."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0035-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
